order: Close the probe and boundary-revision cycle with a final ruling. Combine the two investigator classes into a single class, keeping identical castings at every rung, a five-entry ledger, and the boundary treated as undecidable at intake. Keep the retired class name only as an alias and combine no other classes, so the taxonomy holds at exactly twenty-three classes, while a new decision procedure of seven fixed-order steps decides on the first match and never reopens once a later step is reached. Amend three named boundary rules and retire one, confining the change to those four, since every other boundary rule stays untouched. Reframe classification as a routing hypothesis tied to risk tier plus author family, and restate the downstream gate as misroute recovery. Rewrite the next work order to validate through the router, unblock the gated work order, and close the outstanding pair ledger with dispositions recorded.
claims: The two investigator classes were combined into one class exactly. The taxonomy holds at twenty-three classes, with the retired name kept only as an alias, while read-only-first ordering was internalized and the boundary treated as undecidable at intake. A new decision procedure of seven fixed-order steps was added, with exactly three boundary rules amended and exactly one retired. The gated work order was unblocked, with the pair ledger closed and its dispositions recorded across 3 plan files.
